verdict: Caution: lend selectively to Ankleshwar API/formulation units with contracted offtake and clean working-capital cycles; avoid small CRAMS-only and single-customer converters until receivables and inventory data are verified.
title: Ankleshwar Pharmaceuticals & APIs: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What the business physically is
**Ankleshwar units convert imported and domestic raw materials into APIs, intermediates and tablets, and cash comes back only after a long conversion-and-collection cycle.** The town's anchor plant alone produces more than 6 billion tablets annually and runs chemistry and biotech development on site [2]. So when a proposal lands, check the split between captive/intermediate supply and open-market API sales; if the buyer list is short, ask for the top-five customer share and contract tenure.

## Where value and cash sit
**Value sits in regulatory approvals and customer qualification, not in the reactor; cash sits in receivables and inventory.** Peer rating work shows working-capital intensity of 52% in FY2019, 47% in FY2020 and 48% in 7MFY2021, still called high, driven by elongated receivables and high inventory holding [10]. A CRAMS-heavy peer with Rs. 61.0 crore FY2024 revenue was flagged for modest scale and high customer concentration [8]. So when a proposal lands, check receivable days and inventory days against these benchmarks; if receivables stretch beyond the customer's stated credit terms, ask for the ageing and the largest overdue account.

## What has changed now
**The national data call is Caution at 46, and the local news is mixed rather than bad.** Gujarat GST collections rose 11.9% Apr-to-date against India's 6.1%, and Gujarat power demand rose 11.0% against India's 9.5% [D]. But India-wide output fell 2.1% while bank credit grew 21.6% YoY, a 23.7 pp gap [D] — so when a proposal lands, check whether the borrower's own sales growth is funded by real offtake or by borrowed working capital; if growth outruns output, ask for monthly GST returns and e-way bills. Locally, Zentiva is buying the Sanofi Ankleshwar plant, which will become its largest factory [2], and Zydus is running a mega walk-in for multiple positions [1] — both point to capacity and hiring, not contraction.

## Where to grow, and how to grow safely
**Pursue mid-size API and formulation units with diversified customers and CDMO contracts; avoid single-customer CRAMS converters and thinly capitalised traders.** Peer results support the demand: Aarti Pharmalabs posted record quarterly revenue of Rs. 613 crore, up 47% YoY, with EBITDA margin at 22.2% from 17.7% [4][6], and RPG Life Sciences targets 25% API growth with another acquisition within 12 months [5], though its own Q2 revenue grew 16.5% to Rs. 211.6 crore and the stock fell over 10% [7]. Structure as working-capital limits against receivables with a stock-and-book-debt statement each month, and take monthly GST returns, top-ten debtor ageing and inventory ageing.

## Early-warning signs
**Watch the cash cycle, not the order book.** A peer's working-capital utilisation fell from 70-90% to 40-50% in Q1FY25 while cash and equivalents dropped by Rs. 108 crore [9] — falling utilisation can mean lost sales, not discipline. If receivable days cross the borrower's own prior-year level, ask for the customer-wise ledger; if inventory days rise while sales are flat, ask for batch-wise stock. Note that the rating reports [8][9][10] carry no visible date and the API industry CAGR of 8.4% between CY2017 and CY2022E is from an undated ICRA summary [11] — treat both as old context, not current fact.
watch: Monthly GST returns and e-way bills (monthly)
Sales fall below the borrower's own prior-quarter run-rate -> ask for order book and hold fresh limits
Debtor ageing and top-five customer share (monthly)
Receivable days exceed the borrower's prior-year level -> seek customer-wise ledger and reduce limit
Inventory days rise while sales are flat -> ask for slow-moving stock and re-price the limit
Utilisation drops sharply without sales growth -> ask for cash-flow statement before renewing
Announced expansion or walk-in hiring at the unit -> reassess capex funding need and structure term loan
watch_note: Trigger levels are policy suggestions (analytical framing), not data.
